overall_reason: The page's only figures are a hero row of six catalogue counts, and one of them contradicts the feature card below it: the tile says '29 Landing Patterns' and the card says '14 conversion-optimized page structures'.

score.reason: T-STAT-TILE passes on the labelled counts, but T-CHART-TEXT-MATCH fails because the hero tile and the feature card give different counts for the same thing (DVZ-005).

findings.where: hero stat row, div.grid.grid-cols-3 > div.glass-card-hover:nth-of-type(6), 1440, contact sheet #7, tiles/1440-00.png; 'Landing Patterns' card, tiles/1440-01.png
findings.evidence: The hero tile reads '29 Landing Patterns'. The 'Landing Patterns' feature card one screen below says '14 conversion-optimized page structures'. The other counts roughly agree with their cards ('56 Font Pairings' against '50+ font pairings'; '57 UI Styles' against five named styles 'and 45+ more').
findings.before: Two different counts for the landing patterns on consecutive screens.
findings.after: Use one count, taken from the same source as the database, in both the tile and the card (and in the footer's Database list, which repeats the counts).
findings.why: When two figures for the same thing disagree a reader stops trusting both, and every other count in the row loses weight with them.

strengths: The hero counts each carry a plain label ('57 UI Styles', '95 Color Palettes', '24 Chart Types'): they are counts of the catalogue, so they need no period or baseline.
not_investigated: the data behind each chart: the capture cannot see it, so only what the page shows is judged
tooltips, hover values and keyboard access to data points
charts inside tabs, carousels or menus the capture did not open
charts that animate in: each screenshot is one moment
canvas internals: canvas regions were read from their crops only
whether a source line points to a real source (lens-integrity's)
visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a landing page for a design-skill product with 'Get on GitHub'); there is no 00-contract.md

the two image-chart candidates (contact #1 'SaaS Analytics Dashboard', #2 'Fintech Crypto Dashboard') and the other gallery screenshots are thumbnails of demo sites made with the product: exhibits (conflict C48), not the page's own figures, and their data cannot be read at 409 by 230px
the gradient and glow on the stat-tile cards are the sweep's (SLP-007, SLP-008)
